facts.activity_file: replacing seals and seal support fluid
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

assets.label: seal support coolers
assets.service: barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at HX-4120 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on HX-4120 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. HX-4120 (seal support coolers) is in service for barrier-fluid cooling for the hydrocarbon transfer pump family. The task proceeded during routine operation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 25 January 2023 an incident occurred on HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
